observation.loaded: Engine.dll only, no engine startup performed

crash_site: In CreateDevice(string const&, bool) at 0x90ae0: mov rcx,[0x180421428]; mov rax,[rcx]; call qword ptr [rax+18h]. With a zero global the dereference faults immediately, which matches the 0xC0000005 seen.
conclusion: The device-creation crash was caused by an uninitialised Engine global, not by buffer size, argument order or a wrong export.
what_this_settles: that GraphicsEngineSettings and GraphicsEngine themselves construct correctly
that the next required step is engine startup, not another call variant
remaining_requirement: Something must construct and publish the Engine object into Engine.dll+0x421428 (and the ObjectManager into +0x4213A0) before CreateDevice can succeed. That is the engine startup path the game performs at launch.
not_claimed: that any engine startup entry point is known
that a device can be created
that a frame can be presented
next: Locate the engine startup routine that writes [0x180421428] (an Engine constructor/caller or an init export) and drive that first.
